# BigQuery answers previously recorded in known_bugs.txt: edge snapping may leave a collection,
# and rings that cross or touch at an edge snap to where they meet, possibly at a new vertex.
SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1.000000000006 0, 1.000000000012 0, 0 1, 0 0))')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(LINESTRING(1 0, 1.000000000012 0), POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0), (0.000000000001 0, 0.5 0.1, 0.1 0.5, 0.000000000001 0))')
=> "POLYGON((1e-12 0, 1 0, 0 1, 1e-12 0), (0.1 0.5, 0.5 0.1, 1e-12 0, 0.1 0.5))"

SELECT ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0)'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0.000000000001 0, 0.5 0.1, 0.1 0.5, 0.000000000001 0)')])
=> "POLYGON((1e-12 0, 1 0, 0 1, 1e-12 0), (0.1 0.5, 0.5 0.1, 1e-12 0, 0.1 0.5))"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0.000000000001 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0.000000000001 0), (0 0, 0.5 0.1, 0.1 0.5, 0 0))')
=> "POLYGON((9.99999999995001e-13 5.0001294663102e-12, 1 0, 0 1, 9.99999999995001e-13 5.0001294663102e-12), (0.1 0.5, 0.5 0.1, 9.99999999995001e-13 5.0001294663102e-12, 0.1 0.5))"
